content: Hi, Ann. Are you still working here?
Oh, hi, Jack. Yes, I'm still working part-time in a company, as much as I can. The trouble is that I'm so busy with my classes that I don't have enough time for my work.
Do you have a lot to do?
Well, not too much at the moment.
Are you going to go on working in that company?
I hope so. I really like my work, and next term, I will have more time.
Sounds good. Hope I'll see you around here more often.
OK. I hope to see yon too. Bye for now.
